reasonEN: A medium sorting-and-interval scan problem that turns sparse blocked floors into boundary gaps; practice sorting special positions and handling virtual endpoints; it builds a reliable pattern for complement intervals.
reasonZH: 中等难度的排序与区间扫描题，将稀疏特殊楼层转化为相邻边界间隔；训练排序、端点补齐与边界处理；有助于掌握补集区间的通用建模。

reasonEN: An easy arithmetic problem centered on capacity constraints; identify the limiting dimension and multiply safely; it reinforces extracting the decisive formula from a word problem.
reasonZH: 简单的容量约束数学题，核心是找出限制装载量的维度并正确计算；训练从题意中抽取决定性公式；适合巩固基础建模能力。

reasonEN: An easy ordered-array counting problem with binary-search alternatives; locate the zero boundary or count signs directly; it clarifies how sortedness converts scanning into logarithmic queries.
reasonZH: 简单的有序数组计数题，可用二分定位零的边界或直接统计正负数；训练边界查找与符号分类；帮助理解有序性如何支持对数级查询。

reasonEN: A hard string DP problem combining prefix decisions with fast substring equality checks; pair dynamic programming with rolling hash or matching techniques; it is a strong exercise in optimizing repeated string comparisons.
reasonZH: 困难的字符串动态规划题，需要结合前缀决策与快速子串相等判断；训练 DP 状态设计和滚动哈希或字符串匹配；适合突破重复比较带来的复杂度优化。

reasonEN: A foundational easy tree traversal problem; compute height through recursive DFS or level-order BFS; it establishes the depth aggregation pattern used throughout binary-tree problems.
reasonZH: 基础的简单树遍历题，可用递归 DFS 或层序 BFS 计算高度；训练深度信息的向上聚合；是二叉树题目中最重要的入门模板之一。

reasonEN: An easy N-ary tree traversal variant; aggregate the maximum child depth in DFS or count BFS layers; it extends binary-tree height reasoning to arbitrary branching.
reasonZH: 简单的 N 叉树遍历变体，通过 DFS 聚合最大子深度或 BFS 统计层数；训练多子节点的递归处理；能自然扩展二叉树高度思维。

reasonEN: An easy circular-array scan problem; compare adjacent values and explicitly include the last-to-first pair; it trains recognizing when linear iteration needs cyclic closure.
reasonZH: 简单的循环数组扫描题，比较相邻元素时必须补上首尾一对；训练循环边界意识；可避免线性遍历中常见的漏算问题。

reasonEN: An easy frequency-analysis problem on strings; count characters and compare the required parity groups; it sharpens hash-based counting and constraint filtering.
reasonZH: 简单的字符串频次分析题，统计字符后比较满足奇偶条件的频次；训练哈希计数与条件筛选；适合夯实频率统计基本功。

reasonEN: A hard constrained-substring optimization problem; combine enumeration with prefix states and sliding-window feasibility; it develops skill in maintaining parity information under length constraints.
reasonZH: 困难的受限子串优化题，需要结合枚举、前缀状态与滑动窗口可行性维护；训练长度约束下的奇偶信息管理；对复杂字符串统计很有代表性。

reasonEN: An easy one-pass array optimization problem; retain the smallest prior value while evaluating later larger values; it teaches the prefix-minimum pattern behind many profit and difference tasks.
reasonZH: 简单的一次扫描数组优化题，维护此前最小值并评估后续更大元素；训练前缀最小值模式；是利润与差值类问题的核心基础。

reasonEN: A medium tree DFS problem with path context; propagate ancestor minimum and maximum values while descending; it demonstrates how recursion carries constraints along a root-to-node path.
reasonZH: 中等难度的树 DFS 路径题，向下递归时维护祖先最小值和最大值；训练路径上下文传递；有助于理解递归如何携带祖先约束。

reasonEN: An easy greedy digit-manipulation problem; choose remapped digits to maximize one value and minimize the other under positional rules; it strengthens local-choice reasoning with leading-digit edge cases.
reasonZH: 简单的贪心数字变换题，按位规则选择替换数字以同时放大和缩小结果；训练局部最优判断与前导位边界处理；适合熟悉数位贪心。

reasonEN: A medium matrix DP problem; maintain the best reachable predecessor value while scanning valid directions; it teaches reducing pair comparisons to incremental state updates.
reasonZH: 中等难度的矩阵动态规划题，扫描时维护可达前驱的最优值；训练将大量点对比较压缩为增量状态更新；对网格优化题很有启发性。

reasonEN: A medium monotone-array problem using two pointers or binary search; exploit non-increasing order to advance indices without backtracking; it reinforces how ordering prunes pair searches.
reasonZH: 中等难度的单调数组题，可用双指针或二分利用非递增顺序；训练不回退地推进下标；帮助掌握有序性对配对搜索的剪枝作用。

reasonEN: A medium greedy array problem; maintain global extrema from previous arrays and compare each new array against them; it highlights the importance of preserving source constraints in aggregate optimization.
reasonZH: 中等难度的贪心数组题，维护此前数组的全局极值并与当前数组比较；训练聚合优化时保留来源约束；是跨数组最值问题的典型技巧。

reasonEN: A medium weighted-interval scheduling problem; sort rides and use binary search or position DP to connect compatible jobs; it is a practical entry point to take-or-skip dynamic programming.
reasonZH: 中等难度的带权区间调度题，排序后用二分或位置 DP 连接兼容订单；训练取与不取的动态规划；是区间选择优化的经典入口。

reasonEN: A hard greedy optimization problem mixing sorting, heaps, and distinct-category tracking; replace low-value duplicates only when category gains justify it; it develops exchange arguments for multi-objective selection.
reasonZH: 困难的贪心优化题，结合排序、堆与类别去重维护；只有新增类别收益足够时才替换低价值重复项；训练多目标选择中的交换论证。

reasonEN: A medium sort-and-greedy construction problem; process values in order and cap each next value by the feasible increment; it teaches how sorting turns global rearrangement freedom into a simple invariant.
reasonZH: 中等难度的排序贪心构造题，按序处理并将下一个值限制在可行增量内；训练维护连续可行不变量；理解排序如何简化全局重排约束。

reasonEN: A hard number-theory grouping problem; classify indices by their square-free kernel and aggregate each group; it exposes how factorization reveals hidden equivalence classes in arrays.
reasonZH: 困难的数论分组题，按下标的无平方因子核心分类并聚合元素；训练质因数分解与等价类建模；能理解数论性质如何揭示数组中的隐藏分组。

reasonEN: A hard functional-graph problem; combine topological pruning for incoming chains with cycle analysis for long cycles and mutual pairs; it is a landmark exercise in decomposing directed graphs.
reasonZH: 困难的函数图问题，需要用拓扑剥离统计入链，再分别处理长环与互指二元环；训练有向图分解；是掌握环与树枝结构结合的代表题。

reasonEN: An easy array two-pointer problem; detect opposing occupied endpoints and count the empty segment between them; it practices segment interpretation and reset conditions in a linear scan.
reasonZH: 简单的数组双指针题，识别相反阵营的端点并统计中间空位；训练线性扫描中的区间解释与重置条件；适合巩固双指针基本节奏。

reasonEN: A medium sequence DP problem with switching cost; track the best total ending with each drink choice at every position; it reinforces small-state dynamic programming for mutually exclusive decisions.
reasonZH: 中等难度的序列动态规划题，存在切换代价时维护每种饮料结尾的最优能量；训练互斥选择下的小状态 DP；适合建立状态转移直觉。

reasonEN: A hard frequency-invariant problem; update count-of-counts while checking the few valid distributions after each prefix; it trains turning a global equal-frequency condition into constant-time cases.
reasonZH: 困难的频次不变量题，维护频次及频次数量，并检查每个前缀的少数合法分布；训练把全局等频条件转化为常数个判定分支；很适合提升哈希统计能力。

reasonEN: A medium variable sliding-window problem; maintain unique elements and a running sum while moving the left boundary on duplicates; it combines de-duplication with window-value optimization.
reasonZH: 中等难度的可变滑动窗口题，遇到重复元素时移动左边界并维护元素唯一性和窗口和；训练去重与窗口价值优化的结合；是滑窗核心模板题。

reasonEN: A medium array optimization problem that models each target value as gain and loss contributions; combine enumeration with prefix or Kadane-style DP; it teaches reducing an operation choice to maximum subarray gain.
reasonZH: 中等难度的数组优化题，可将每个目标值建模为增益和损失贡献；结合枚举与前缀或 Kadane 式 DP；训练把一次操作转化为最大子数组收益。

reasonEN: A medium sorted-window optimization problem; use sorting with binary search, prefix sums, or a sliding window to measure reachable values; it develops cost accounting for bounded value adjustments.
reasonZH: 中等难度的排序窗口优化题，可借助二分、前缀和或滑动窗口衡量可达值范围；训练受限数值调整的成本核算；对频率最大化问题很实用。

reasonEN: A hard extension of frequency maximization with operation-count limits; coordinate sorted windows, prefix sums, and feasibility calculations; it tests whether a medium window model can scale under tighter constraints.
reasonZH: 困难的频率最大化进阶题，额外受操作次数限制，需要协调排序窗口、前缀和与可行性计算；训练在更强约束下扩展滑窗模型；适合检验复杂度控制能力。

reasonEN: A hard data-structure design problem; index stacks by frequency while tracking the current maximum frequency for O(1) operations; it demonstrates how complementary hash maps and stacks encode priority with recency ties.
reasonZH: 困难的数据结构设计题，按频率维护栈并记录当前最高频率以实现 O(1) 操作；训练哈希表与栈的协同设计；能理解频率优先且最近优先的编码方式。

reasonEN: A hard position-based sliding-window problem; use prefix sums and evaluate the travel cost of covering each interval from the start; it sharpens geometric reasoning inside range optimization.
reasonZH: 困难的位置型滑动窗口题，利用前缀和并评估从起点覆盖各区间的步数成本；训练区间优化中的路径几何推理；是前缀和与窗口结合的高质量题目。

reasonEN: A medium non-comparison sorting problem; use radix or bucket partitioning to bound where the maximum adjacent gap can occur; it teaches the pigeonhole-style insight behind linear-time sorting approaches.
reasonZH: 中等难度的非比较排序题，利用基数排序或桶划分缩小最大相邻间距的位置范围；训练线性时间排序中的抽屉原理思维；适合理解桶排序的关键洞见。
